scene_brief: Winter morning INSIDE home after failed snowy bathroom outing. Neet has burrowed under a soft ordinary blanket on floor beside couch: real low prone body volume under blanket, his neck/head and two connected fine forepaws visible at its opening, large ears partly covered naturally, dry defiant sideways glance toward unseen Heather. Buddy lies a short distance away near an ordinary wall heater, his full elongated side body visible, folded rear thigh and extended front paws, chin raised slightly toward Neet with tired mild amusement. Both separately grounded. Pale snowy backyard visible through window establishes outside cold; room warm and quiet. No humans needed, no fire, no floating head without body volume, no clothes or props from photo backgrounds. The joke is Neet treating an incomplete mission as a cozy victory while Buddy, who finished, wants his own paws warm.
placement_after: Neet peeked out from his blanket fortress. "We’ll see."
alt_text: Neet peers from his warm blanket while Buddy settles by the heater after doing his part outside.
